concerns.text: The plan falls back to a verified GHZ placeholder dataset that does **not contain plant metabolite or herbivory measurements** (see Phase 1.3). Yet the research objective claims to *quantify* associations between metabolite classes and herbivore damage. Validating a biological hypothesis on a dataset that lacks the very variables of interest makes the validation scientifically meaningless; any reported correlations or model performance are artefacts of random data, not evidence for the hypothesis.

The research section states the goal to *quantify* metabolite‑herbivore relationships, but also admits that “the core scientific question cannot be answered with real data; the pipeline will therefore run on a verified placeholder dataset solely to validate the workflow.” This contradiction means the core scientific question is unsalvageable in its current form; the study can only demonstrate pipeline functionality, not test the hypothesis.
